# Noto Sans Regular test glyphs

`0-255.pbf` contains the existing native label font's first glyph range. It is used by packaged browser tests without a network dependency. The product font contract remains unchanged.

Retrieved 2026-10-04 from https://demotiles.maplibre.org/font/Noto%20Sans%20Regular/0-255.pbf.

SHA-256: `ef1f38a3f1978591e846e9eaddf8a54f7047f546fc6aaed7872cc53151a5de78`.

[MapLibre's provenance](https://github.com/maplibre/demotiles/blob/gh-pages/README.md) identifies [OpenMapTiles fonts](https://github.com/openmaptiles/fonts) as the source fonts and generation scripts. The adjacent `LICENSE` is the Noto Sans SIL Open Font License from [that repository at d48c5fce](https://github.com/openmaptiles/fonts/blob/d48c5fce2fc58b55c98d353558d807cac45e7262/noto-sans/LICENSE). This fixture is an unchanged copy of the generated glyph file.
